blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — More motorists are being flagged for alleged illegal drag racing along Ouano Avenue and other national highways in Mandaue City. The most recent operation was conducted along Ouano Avenue late Thursday evening after the city government received a report of alleged drag racing in the area. Gerard Gleen Soon Gobalani, team leader of the City Mayor’s Office-Safety Maintenance Area Response Team, said personnel conducted surveillance in civilian clothes to avoid being identified and were able to document the alleged races on video.
